user.title: Connect Taschengeld
user.description: Create a token in the Taschengeld app under *Family → Interface* (`/family/home-assistant`). It can only read balances and can be revoked there at any time.

data_description.url: Only https:// addresses are allowed. Change this only if you host Taschengeld yourself.
data_description.token: The token created by a parent. It contains a `|`, that is normal.

reauth_confirm.title: Token no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: The token was revoked or is no longer accepted. Create a new token in the Taschengeld app under *Family → Interface* and enter it here.

error.invalid_url: Invalid address. It must start with https://.
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or has been revoked.
error.no_permission: The token is not allowed to read balances (child tokens do not work).
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.service_unavailable: Taschengeld is under maintenance or overloaded. Please try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token has been saved.

data_description.scan_interval: Between 30 and 1440 minutes. Balances rarely change, so the default of 180 is plenty.

invalid_auth.message: The Taschengeld token is invalid or has been revoked.

no_permission.message: The Taschengeld token is not allowed to read balances.

rate_limited.message: Taschengeld reports too many requests; waiting before the next attempt.

service_unavailable.message: Taschengeld is under maintenance or overloaded; waiting before the next attempt.
